## Summary

The codebase is a Spring/OfficeFloor PetClinic variant. The identifiers form an **owner "derived-identity" subsystem**: small single-purpose model classes each compute one derived field, wired into the owner-creation pipeline (`owners.POST.yml`) and exposed on the owner response via `OwnerMapper`.

Note one important discrepancy: `src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` asserts a **future `memberId`** that unifies `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` into `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`. That `memberId` field does **not** exist yet in the main source or `openapi.yml` — the test currently describes a target state that is not implemented.

## Main source — model classes (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/`)

- **`Hash8.java`** — `Hash8.of(Owner)` (lines 18-21). The HASH8 "owner identity hash" segment: first 8 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over `telephone + lastName` (normalized E.164 telephone). Null telephone/lastName contribute empty string.
- **`Sha256.java`** — `Sha256.hex(String)` (lines 20-33). The single place SHA-256 (lower-case hex, UTF-8) is computed. Used by `Hash8`, `IdentityKey`, `AssignHousehold`.
- **`Luhn.java`** — `Luhn.digit(String)` (lines 19-38). Single Luhn check-digit algorithm (right-to-left, double every second digit, ignore non-digits).
- **`CheckDigit.java`** — `CheckDigit.of(Owner)` (lines 14-20). The owner's `checkDigit` = `Luhn.digit(customerCode)`; null when no customerCode.
- **`FiscalYear.java`** — `FiscalYear.of(Owner)` → `"FY<YY>"` (lines 28-34), `shortYear(LocalDate)` (37-39), `yearOf(LocalDate)` (42-44). Fiscal year starts 1 July, labelled by ending calendar year (`START_MONTH = JULY`).
- **`MembershipNumber.java`** — `MembershipNumber.of(Owner)` (lines 18-23). `<customerCode>-M<YY>` where YY is `FiscalYear.shortYear(registrationDate)`. Null when no customerCode or registrationDate.
- **`Locality.java`** — region-code logic. `regionOf(String postcode)` (line 63) is the REGION segment of customerCode (postcode ranges NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else `UNKNOWN`). `of(Owner)` (73-82) reads region back out of the customerCode prefix. Also `of(String city)`, `of(String city, String postcode)`, `fromPostcode`.
- **`IdentityKey.java`** — `IdentityKey.of(Owner)` (lines 24-28). SHA-256 identity hash over `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)`; the single value all duplicate detection keys on.
- **`OwnerSegment.java`** — `OwnerSegment.of(Owner)` (lines 18-22). The "owner segment" marketing field `<TIER>_<AREA>` (PREMIUM/STANDARD by MembershipLevel≥3; METRO/REGIONAL by Locality).
- **`Owner.java`** — field `customerCode` (line 74, `@Column(name = "customer_code")`); getter/setter `getCustomerCode`/`setCustomerCode` (lines 186-191).

## Main source — creation pipeline (`src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/`)

- **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — class `AssignCustomerCode.service(...)` (lines 21-27). Computes `customerCode = region + "-" + Hash8.of(owner)` where `region = Locality.regionOf(postcode)` (e.g. `NSW-1A2B3C4D`). **Collision handling** lives here: `deduplicate(base, existingCodes)` (lines 41-51) appends `-<n>` with smallest `n ≥ 2` not already taken; `existingCodes` (29-38) scans `ownerRepository.findAll()`.
- **`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`** — `service(...)` (lines 28-39). Rejects create (409) when `IdentityKey.of(owner)` equals an existing non-deleted owner's; throws `OwnerIdentityConflictException`.
- **`AssignHousehold.java`** — `service(...)` (lines 21-22). `householdId` = first 12 hex of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode` (uses `Sha256.hex`).
- **`AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — class `AuditOwnerCreated.service(@Val Owner)` (lines 31-38). **The audit records.** Logs a human-readable line (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel, `MembershipNumber.of(owner)`) plus a JSON `OwnerCreatedEvent` on the dedicated `AUDIT` logger; `SEQ` is a monotonic `AtomicLong`.
- **`OwnerCreatedEvent.java`** — record `OwnerCreatedEvent(seq, ownerId, customerCode, membershipLevel)`. `of(seq, owner)` (30-33), `primaryIdentifier(owner)` returns `customerCode` (40-42), `toJson()` (48-58). Comments flag the future unification into memberId.
- **`OwnerIdentityConflictException.java`** (`rest/escalation/`) — thrown on identityKey collision, carries `identityKey`, mapped to 409.

## Main source — mapper & resources

- **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — the wiring exposing these on `OwnerDto`: `checkDigit` (line 26 → `CheckDigit.of`), `membershipNumber` (27 → `MembershipNumber.of`), `fiscalYear` (28 → `FiscalYear.of`), `locality` (31 → `Locality.of`), `identityKey` (35 → `IdentityKey.of`), `ownerSegment` (36 → `OwnerSegment.of`).
- **`resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — pipeline order. `checkIdentity` (line 40-41, `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique`), `assignCustomerCode` (64-65), `audit` (107-108, `AuditOwnerCreated`). Comment block lines 36-39 documents the identityKey duplicate rule.
- **`resources/openapi.yml`** — schema/docs: `customerCode` (line 2170), `checkDigit` (2180), `membershipNumber` (2191), `fiscalYear` (2201), `locality` (~2257), `ownerSegment` (2293), `identityKey` (~2322). ## Test files (`src/test/java/.../acceptance/`)

- **`AcceptanceTest.java`** — class `AcceptanceTest`, test `coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId()` (lines 12-20). Expects a unified `memberId` = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, asserts prefix `NSW`, contains `shaHex(telephone+lastName, 8)`, and that `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are **removed**. Header comment lines 7-9. (Describes a not-yet-implemented target.)
- **`AcceptanceBase.java`** — test-side replicas of the algorithms: `sha256hex(String)` (282-294), `shaHex(s, n)` upper-case prefix (297-299), `luhn(String)` (302-321). Region ground-truth maps `CITY_REGION` (228), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (232), `REGION_POSTCODES` (236); helpers `region(city)` (244-246), `validPostcode` (252-256).
- **`AuditLogCapture.java`** — utility capturing events on the `AUDIT` logger (class `AuditLogCapture`, lines 25-35), used to assert audit records.

## How the three headline fields are computed today

- **customerCode**: `AssignCustomerCode` → `Locality.regionOf(postcode) + "-" + Hash8.of(owner)`, then `deduplicate` appends `-2`, `-3`, … on collision. Stored on `Owner.customerCode` (`customer_code` column).
- **membershipNumber**: derived (not stored) in `MembershipNumber.of` as `<customerCode>-M<fiscalYearShortYear(registrationDate)>`; exposed via mapper and read by the audit line.
- **checkDigit**: derived in `CheckDigit.of` as `Luhn.digit(customerCode)`; exposed via mapper only.

            selfLink:
              title: Self link

            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the owner's own fields: the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName when a title is present
                (e.g. 'DR who'), otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the fiscalYear derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July
                falls in the following year's fiscal year (e.g. 1 July 2025 -> 'FY26').
                Null when no registrationDate is set. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the customerCode (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD';
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment this owner was created (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50);
                false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)'
                (the email segment is empty when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identityKey equals an existing non-deleted owner's. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '3b8e0a1c2d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, has an identityKey that
                differs from an existing owner's while its soundex(lastName) and postcode
                both match; false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-

                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /owners/{id}; the
                record is retained rather than removed. False for a newly created owner.
                Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional. When present it drives the
            derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility, and also returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag, retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is
            now expressed solely through the identityKey (SHA-256 over
            normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)); this flag no longer affects
            whether a create is rejected with 409 or flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the owner's own fields: the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName when a title is present
                (e.g. 'DR who'), otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else
                UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit fiscal year derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated
                with lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits
                of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. Assigned at creation; '-<n>' is appended on
                collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
